description.narrative: (Ethiopia): The Health Financing Improvement Program (HFIP) strengthens health financing functions and systems to support Universal Health Coverage of essential health care for Ethiopian citizens by reducing financial barriers through institutionalizing different Health Care Financing (HCF) reforms. USAID, through this activity, works to increase domestic resource mobilization (DRM) for health, financial risk-protection programs (Community-Based Health Insurance (CBHI) and Social Health Insurance), and improve local capacity for better decision-making and resource management. With FY 2021 funds, among others, HFIP will focus on further widening of the CBHI coverage in rural areas, rollout of the CBHI program to urban cities, scaling-up in low-land/developing regions, primarily for PF programs and other Public Health Programs like MCH. Extra effort will also be exerted to mitigate the impact of COVID-19 and other shocks the country is experiencing and maintain CBHI memberships and new enrollments..These efforts directly support Ethiopia's Integrated Country Strategy Mission Goal 3: Spur Broad-based Economic Growth and Mission Objective 3.3: Ethiopia Increases Utilization of Quality Health Services and Improves Capacity to Prevent and Manage Pandemic and Epidemic Health Threats...... .
